import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation fields. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}
{event_title}
{event_description}
Date: {event_date}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation( e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str ) -> str: """ Produce a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The title of the event. e_description : str A detailed description; may contain newlines or formatting. e_date : str The scheduled date of the event. e_notes : str Any additional notes or instructions. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string safe for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user supplied content to mitigate XSS (CWE‑79). safe_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=True) # Populate the template with the escaped values. return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
